label: Mondial Relay Delivery
description: Create Mondial Relay Connect shipments, print delivery labels, and track stored parcels through a Supabase connector.

instructions: Apply the bundled Supabase schema and Edge Function to the configured project.
Configure the Mondial Relay Connect login, password, customer id, and CMS delivery API key in Supabase Function secrets.
Install the delivery source and dashboard backed by the deployed function URL.
checks: The CMS only stores the source configuration and private CMS API key reference.
Mondial Relay Connect credentials live only in Supabase Function secrets.
Create requests forward x-cms-user-id for audit context.
The connector schema stays private to anon and authenticated roles.
resources: Generated private CMS delivery API key
Private delivery schema and Edge Function
review: Keep the delivery schema private to anon and authenticated roles.
Do not expose Mondial Relay Connect passwords, Supabase service-role keys, or generated CMS API keys to browser code.
Use externalOrderId only as an integration reference; this module does not own commerce orders.
ui.syncNote: This integration creates a stateless CMS source. Supabase owns delivery rows, editable delivery settings, and Mondial Relay API calls.
